source: John Deere Section Setup + operator confirm nozzle 1 = left, 2026-06-11
boom_order_note: Left to right facing forward. Nozzle 1 = L5 outboard (far left).

exactapply_subnets.numbering: Left to right, facing direction of forward travel. Subnet 1 = far left.
exactapply_subnets.within_subnet_order: First nozzle body in each subnet is closest to the **center of the machine** (inboard); counts vary per subnet.

boundaries_hypothesis.note: Exact nozzle boundaries per subnet not in Help text. Diagnostics Center nozzle-body status pages unavailable after recent display update (operator 2026-06-11). Using section-frame split below until key-on sniff or NZC traffic analysis refines it.

within_subnet_indexing.note: Global Work Setup index: nozzle 1 = L5 outboard (left tip). JD subnet-local index: first = inboard (toward centre), then outboard. These are opposite ends on subnet 1.
within_subnet_indexing.addressing_flow: Key-on: MNC sends addressing on Sync circuit to inboard-most NZC on subnet, then Sync Out → Sync In daisy-chain outboard.
within_subnet_indexing.sync_flow: After addressing: 15 Hz heartbeat enters inboard NZC, passes in-series outboard on Sync circuit.

nozzle_body_hardware.source: JD Help Center — Nozzle Body Circuits, Sync Circuit, Addressing Mode, Sync Mode, 2026-06-11

can_circuit.topology: Daisy-chain pass-through per subnet (CAN Hi/Lo In and Out on each NZC).
can_circuit.protocol: CAN to MNC master controller; NZC has internal 12V-powered control unit per body.

sync_circuit.topology: Series circuit — NOT pass-through like CAN; Sync Out of NZC N → Sync In of NZC N+1.

functions.addressing: Key-on: each NZC reports physical position on boom; runs per subnet.
functions.heartbeat: Sync Mode: 15 Hz signal keeps boom time-aligned for solenoid pulse timing.

failure_modes.power_circuit_break: Broken sync at faulted NZC → all outboard NZCs on that subnet fault (as if Sync Out unplugged).
failure_modes.diagnostic_hint: Inboard NZCs on subnet may still be OK; outboard chain dead.

control_layers.note: Three independent layers seen on X119 sniff vs boom subnets.

layers.use: Manual soft-key / IBS section bitmap; unchanged during ASC on headland.
